No dangerous operations such as runtime downloads, `eval` calls, or file exfiltration are present in this metadata file. The use of HTTPS and specific version tags (e.g., v0.1.1) ensures that the sources are pinned and reproducible. While the license is permissive (Apache-2.0), that does not affect the supply-chain safety of the package as distributed.
</details>
